description: Prepare a private screenshot artifact upload for the exact Preview renderer revision and desktop/mobile viewport. The response is a closed union on `outcome`: PENDING_UPLOAD carries the short-lived signed PUT (must not be logged); ALREADY_READY means the same-key capture is already verified and `upload` is null — do NOT upload or finalize, the verified artifact is the readback. A same-key retry of a FAILED artifact re-arms it to PENDING with a cleared failure and a fresh pending window. Requires lms:write.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable idempotency key. Reuse only for the identical operation.

name: opentrain_lms_prepare_preview_artifact
